## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` passes

## Security (tick all that apply, explain below)

- [ ] Adds a dependency (the Python side has none today)
- [ ] Adds an outbound network call, or loads anything from another site

- [ ] Touches pairing, the owner key, the terminal, settings validation or the CSP
- [ ] None of the above
